scenario: the first practical exchange about weather & daily plans
english_title: Recognising and Responding to the First Practical Exchange About Weather and Daily Plans
vietnamese_title: Giao tiếp nền tảng: weather & daily plans — the first practical exchange about weather & daily plans
primary_communication_goal: recognise and respond to the first practical exchange about weather & daily plans; complete the exchange naturally at A0 / Pre-A1.
context_note_en: Mr David comments on the sunny weather to Ms Lan.
context_note_vi: Anh David nói về thời tiết nắng đẹp với chị Lan.

turns.speaker: Mr David
turns.english: Lan, it is very sunny today.
turns.vietnamese: Lan này, hôm nay nắng đẹp quá.

turns.speaker: Ms Lan
turns.english: Yes, I should wear my hat.
turns.vietnamese: Vâng, tôi nên đội mũ mới được.

turns.speaker: Ms Lan
turns.vietnamese: Cảm ơn anh đã nhắc tôi.
